description: This file defines interfaces related to stream queue load balancing in Orleans, including IStreamQueueBalancer and IStreamQueueBalanceListener, with methods for initialization, shutdown, queue retrieval, and event subscription.

classes.name: IStreamQueueBalancer
classes.description: Interface for load balancing queues across related queue balancers, with methods for initialization, shutdown, retrieving queues, and managing event subscriptions.

classes.name: IStreamQueueBalanceListener
classes.description: Interface for components that receive notifications when the queue distribution changes in the stream queue balancer.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer with a queue mapper.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Retrieves the latest queue distribution for this balancer.

methods.name: SubscribeToQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to receive queue distribution change notifications.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from receiving queue distribution change notifications.

methods.name: QueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Called when the queue responsibility changes, notifying the listener of the change.
